messages.subject: Harrow v Brevdale Castings — disclosure deadline next week
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah — unrelated to the Marsden settlement, but a heads-up that standard disclosure in the Brevdale Castings claim is due on 27 March. Counsel wants the metallurgy expert's draft before then. I'll keep that running separately so it doesn't get tangled up with the employment file.

Elena
